prompt:
EXPLICIT SAME-NPC NEUTRAL REPAIR. ONE isolated full-body figure, true RGBA PNG alpha. No painted checkerboard, white/grey/black matte, paper texture, grid, shadow, aura, labels or scene. Empty/background pixels must be alpha0. Keep full crown, boots and props inside generous transparent margins.

IMAGE1 live Wang SOUTHWEST remains PRIMARY human anatomy/pixel/camera. IMAGE2 is this SAME NPC earlier target-view source, the correction target; it contains the errors below. Keep own accepted compact head/body identity, face/hair/wardrobe/props/material colors. Apply ONLY the stated repair; do not create a different NPC or copy Wang identity.

Fix BOTH opaque drawn checkerboard and wrong Southeast camera. True SOUTHWEST FRONT-LEFT nose/gaze LEFT/down-left like Image1, near cheek screen-right and far eye screen-left foreshortened. Image2 currently points page-right: that view is WRONG and must be reconstructed, never mirrored. Anatomical RIGHT folded paper and patched shoulder are FAR/screen-left/up, mostly occluded; LEFT-hip tube is NEAR/screen-right/down. No duplicate map, new face or extra decoration.

Physical attachments: Folded route paper in anatomical RIGHT hand; compact map tube/cord at anatomical LEFT hip; cloak patch on anatomical RIGHT shoulder. FRONT projects paper/patch screen-left and tube screen-right; BACK projects paper/patch screen-right and tube screen-left. Keep front paper naturally occluded from behind, not pasted on back. No duplicate sheet or tube. Projection: FRONT-LEFT: anatomical RIGHT arm/hip is the FAR side, screen-LEFT/up, mostly occluded by torso. Anatomical LEFT arm/hip is NEAR, screen-RIGHT/down. Never move a RIGHT-hand/RIGHT-hip item to the visible LEFT near side.

Retain accepted large chibi skull/head around half standing height, short torso/legs and original short robe hem. No long adult torso or taller coat. One consistent neutral, no software deformation. Body native80px/base64x96/foot32,88; padded96x96/foot48,88 is padding only; source scale measured from crown/boots later. New view remains owner-review candidate.
